about_the_game:
This is the demo version of Roshamboss, a 3v1 boss-battling card game for 4 friends based on the classic game of Rock Paper Scissors.

It's a bit like your weekly Poker group and Among Us had a baby.

WHAT'S IN THE DEMO?

We have a limited roster for Next Fest:

  • 3 Bosses

  • 5 Heroes

Your feedback helps us make Roshamboss better. The game will launch in Early Access as soon as we're able to address that feedback.

WHO IS THIS GAME FOR?

Roshamboss is built for people that like:

  • Simple choices with weirdly deep strategy

  • Psychoanalyzing their friends

  • Catching people slipping 

GAMEPLAY

Outwit the Boss in turn-based combat to reduce their HP to 0:

  • 1 player chooses a Boss with abilities that twist the rules of Rock Paper Scissors in unique ways

  • The other 3 players build a team comp from a roster of tank, dps, healer, and support Heroes

  • When gameplay begins, the Boss places a card facedown and the fun starts. 

The Heroes have to pick up on the Boss’s patterns and work together if they're going to survive.

Roshamboss is designed to be easy to learn and different every game:

  • 20 to 40 minute matches

  • Use game-changing abilities and ultimates to shape your outcomes

  • Uncover powerful synergies and surprising team plays

  • Read your friends' minds or bluff your way to victory

WHAT OUR PLAYERS SAY

  • "It's like poker, but for people who want it to be more interesting."

  • "There's no way it's scissors."

  • "He's definitely a paper boy."

  • "It's 100% rock."

BUILT BY A SMALL TEAM

Gumption Games is a small team of 7. If y'all like Roshamboss, we have plenty of content to deliver:

  • 20+ Bosses with a unique playstyles and win conditions

  • 80+ Heroes designed and ready for testing

If you enjoyed the game and want to help us make it better, please join the Discord!
